_note_exclude_samples: exclude_samples: MC samples left out of every plotted yield (the HT < 400 GeV QCD samples, pileup double counting; as in qcd_est.py and the SR scan).
_note_blinding: Blinding (default; --unblind disables it): the fill stage removes every data event inside a signal region of signal_region_csv (score box and all selection.json thresholds). Trees without signal regions (control regions) must be listed in unblinded_trees.
_note_hist_refine: The fill stage stores each branch with hist_refine x its plot bins (plus under/overflow), so the plot stage can rebin and restyle; ranges without an x_range override come from a scan of the first range_scan_entries entries per sample.
_note_n_workers: n_workers: parallel pool size for pre-pass, streaming, and rendering. null = cpu_count.
_note_plot_branches: Set plot_branches per tree to restrict which branches are plotted. null or absent key plots all branches.
_note_plot_thresholds: Plot-only event selection, independent of selections/BDT/selection.json. Scalar = col > value. [lo, hi] = lo < col < hi. Applied even with --no-selection.
